# What's your Section 199A qualified business income deduction worth?

> Estimate the 20% qualified business income deduction, including the SSTB phase-out and the W-2 wage / UBIA limit for a single qualified trade or business. Entirely client-side.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [Why is my QBI deduction $0 (or much less than 20%)?](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/qbi-deduction-calculator/why-is-my-qbi-deduction-0.html)
